title: Scientific Inquiry: From Observation to Explanation
central_question: How can I move from noticing a phenomenon to building and testing a defensible explanation?
target_capability: Plan and communicate a small, evidence-informed investigation, including a model, uncertainty, and limitations.
learner_profile: Curious beginner; no specialist science background assumed.

steps.purpose: Separate observations from interpretations and turn curiosity into a focused question.
assessment_evidence: A clearly framed investigable question and observation record.

steps.purpose: Define variables, measurement procedures, controls, and a feasible test.
assessment_evidence: A repeatable investigation plan with units and measurement considerations.

steps.purpose: Develop a provisional explanation and derive predictions from an explicit model.
assessment_evidence: A hypothesis, prediction, assumptions, and stated model limits.

steps.purpose: Compare observations with predictions, characterize uncertainty, and revise conclusions.
assessment_evidence: An evidence-based conclusion that addresses uncertainty and alternatives.

steps.purpose: Make the method auditable and formulate a worthwhile next question.
assessment_evidence: A reproducible record and an independently framed follow-up investigation.

exit_capability: Learner can independently frame and plan a small investigation, evaluate evidence against a model, state limitations, and propose a next inquiry.
